settings.question: When do I get paid?
settings.answer: Payment is sent within [payment_days] business days of us receiving your device. Drop it off in one of our stores and we can pay you on the spot.

settings.question: What if the condition doesn't match my quote?
settings.answer: We'll send you a revised offer. Accept it, or decline and we'll return your device free.

settings.question: Is shipping free?
settings.answer: Yes. We send a free shipping label. Just make sure it ships within [quote_days] days of your quote.

settings.question: What happens to my data?
settings.answer: Every device we buy is fully wiped. Before you send it, back up your data, sign out of iCloud or your Google account, and remove your SIM card.

settings.question: Can I put the value toward a new device instead?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose the trade-in option and apply your value toward any device in our store.
